item.title: ‘Pause in procedure’ organ donation bill clears Ky. House
item.description: A bill that institutes an additional safety step during the organ procurement process passed unanimously in the House last week. House Bill 510, sponsored by Jason Nemes, R-Middletown, would allow a “pause in procedure” in organ donation.
